mentions.name: FastComments
mentions.description: This comment platform is gaining a native C++ desktop app (no Electron) with a combined forum feature, so community chats from somewhere like Discord get indexed and searchable through a web forum-style interface.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still building https://FastComments.com :) I'm planning on launching a desktop app for it soon with a combined forum. So you could have a community on something like discord, but all the chats are indexed and searchable through a web forum style interface as well.

mentions.name: FastComments AI agents
mentions.description: This project expands the FastComments commenting platform's SDK and plugin space with AI agents that moderate comments. AI mods mark comments with a 'bot' tag, the system emails users why a decision was made with an option to contest it that loops in a real person, and agents can non-invasively notify moderators when comments violate community standards or give out awards. Longer term the author plans to run self-hosted LLM hardware so user data isn't shared with third parties.
mentions.problem: AI moderation can anger real users; the challenge is building it to provide value to site owners without making half the users mad.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also expanding the SDK and plugin space for https://fastcomments.com and am planning on adding AI agents because everyone expects that now :)
